Apache Ossie exchanges semantic metadata. It does not become an ingestion service, query engine, cache, access-control runtime, or BI presentation layer merely because a model describes the result.

Specification status

Portable metadata is not portable execution.

The catalog never uses opaque custom extensions to pretend a missing capability is standardized. Security, caching, ingestion, materialization, query parameters, and BI interactions remain with the producer or consuming runtime unless Apache Ossie defines them directly.
